description: This PHP class 'VueControllerHelper' provides helper methods for managing Vue.js component data, user info, menu items, breadcrumb navigation, theme data, and permissions within the OrangeHRM system. It integrates various traits and services to assemble context parameters for Vue components in the HRM web application.

classes.name: VueControllerHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing Vue.js component context, user info, menu, breadcrumb, theme, and permissions in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP request object.

methods.name: getContextParams
methods.description: Assembles and returns context parameters for Vue components, including user info, menu, breadcrumb, theme, and permissions.

methods.name: getAssetsVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current assets version timestamp.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the current logged-in user's ID.

methods.name: getUserObject
methods.description: Builds and returns user information including name, profile image URL, and password status.

methods.name: getMenuItems
methods.description: Retrieves menu items for the current request base URL.

methods.name: getContextItems
methods.description: Retrieves current screen context title and icon.

methods.name: getBreadcrumb
methods.description: Builds breadcrumb navigation data based on current module and screen.

methods.name: getHelpUrl
methods.description: Constructs URL for help documentation based on current module and screen.
